cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.
